t: A pocket-size, battery-powered sound box for effects, sampling, and synth sounds.
steps: Buy a Kastle 2 from the Bastl shop or a music store. Pick FX Wizard, Wave Bard, or Alchemist.
Put in three AA batteries or plug in a USB-C cable.
Plug headphones into the headphone jack.
Turn the knobs and patch one of the included cables to hear the change.
Read the Kastle 2 manual to learn each mode.
Load your own sounds with the Wave Bard web sample loader.
For coding, follow the toolchain guide in the kastle2 repo and build the FX Wizard firmware.
meta: Open Board. From $176. A few stores.
